description:
The Eversolo DMP-A8 isn't just a device; it's an entry into a world where every note of your music is elevated to its purest form. This all-in-one streamer, DAC, amp, and preamp is a masterpiece crafted for both the audiophile and the casual listener, merging the soul of vinyl with the convenience of digital streaming.

At its heart, the Eversolo DMP-A8 features the flagship AKM DAC with Velvet Sound Technology. This premium converter transforms digital music into a warm, rich audio experience, rivaling high-end audio systems. The dual AKM4499EX DAC chips further enhance sound clarity and depth.
name: Eversolo DMP-A8 All-In-One Streamer, DAC Amp, Preamp

description:
The Premium Compact Wireless Speaker Your Music Deserves

Mu-so Qb 2nd Generation is the latest member of the award-winning Mu-so wireless music system family. Re-engineered from the ground up to create our best compact wireless music system yet.
name: Naim Mu-so Qb 2nd Generation

description:
The Eversolo DMP-A6 emerges as an all-in-one DAC and streamer, meticulously crafted for extreme flexibility and lossless playback. With professional audio tuning, it stands as a testament to Eversolo's commitment to revolutionize music streaming.

Encased in a solid aluminum alloy chassis, the DMP-A6 boasts a 6" LCD color touchscreen. The deeply tailored user interface, based on Android 11, offers an intuitive and responsive experience, ensuring seamless interaction with the device's extensive features.
name: Eversolo DMP-A6 Streamer and DAC

description:
HIFIMAN’s Ananda BT 2024 is the latest evolution in their groundbreaking series of Bluetooth planar magnetic headphones, designed for audiophiles who crave exceptional sound quality without the hassle of wires. This new edition builds on the success of its predecessors with a host of technological upgrades, including the integration of the Hymalaya R2R DAC, Stealth Magnet technology, and HIFIMAN’s NEO "supernano" diaphragm. Whether you’re streaming wirelessly or connected via USB, the Ananda BT 2024 offers unparalleled audio clarity, detail, and musicality in a comfortable, ergonomic design.

One of the standout features of the Ananda BT 2024 is the inclusion of HIFIMAN’s proprietary Hymalaya R2R DAC. This advanced digital-to-analog converter significantly enhances the audio performance of the headphones, providing superior resolution, depth, and tonal accuracy. The R2R DAC is based on a unique FPGA algorithm, which offers ultra-low out-of-band noise and consumes minimal power. This results in crystal-clear sound reproduction, elevating Bluetooth audio to a level that rivals wired connections.
name: Hifiman Ananda BT Wireless Headphones - 2024 Edition

description:
The Klipsch Detroit Portable Bluetooth Speaker brings the spirit of Motown right into your hands. Featuring dual 1” horn-loaded tweeters, it delivers 360° audio that envelops you in sound. Paired with dual passive radiators, the Detroit offers deep, resonating bass, ensuring rich lows and clear vocals for an unmatched audio performance that keeps you grooving on the go.

Designed for the long haul, the Klipsch Detroit ensures your music keeps playing throughout the night, offering up to 20 hours of battery life on a single charge. Whether you’re exploring the vibrant streets of downtown or cruising along the iconic Motor City avenues, this speaker is your reliable companion, ensuring the rhythm never stops.
name: Klipsch Detroit Portable Bluetooth Speaker

description:
Introducing the iFi Audio Aurora Wireless Bluetooth Speaker System – the ultimate all-in-one music system that combines extraordinary sound quality with captivating design. Whether it's in your home, office, or garden, the Aurora offers music lovers a pure and simple experience. Prepare to be mesmerized by music that looks and sounds absolutely incredible.

Experience the fusion of French design and Japanese inspiration in the Aurora's striking appearance. Designer Julien Haziza drew inspiration from renowned Japanese industrial designers and architecture, resulting in a design that perfectly balances the clean lines of Japanese architecture with a hint of vintage charm. Clad in bamboo and elevated by an aluminum frame, the Aurora's design echoes the grandeur of Japanese aesthetics, making it an iconic addition to any space.
name: iFi Audio Aurora Wireless Bluetooth Speaker System

description:
The most complete powered streaming speaker available, combining Bluetooth, and multi room capabilities the PULSE 2i fills large spaces with rich, clear high-res audio. When it comes to your music, don’t settle for anything less than high-fidelity.

Right out of the box the PULSE 2i uses your home wireless network and sets up quickly. Simply open the BluOS Controller app on your mobile device and follow the short setup instructions. While inside the app users can choose their listening preferences, program presets for their favorite radio stations, music streaming services and playlists, and even set alarms. Once the PULSE 2i is online connectivity stays rock-solid thanks to a new dual band Wi-Fi engine.
name: Bluesound Pulse 2i Wireless Multi-Room Streaming Speaker

description:
Introducing the Klipsch GIG XXL, a portable powerhouse that epitomizes Klipsch's 70 years of audio excellence. This wireless speaker packs a punch, delivering a sound that's not just big, but clear, detailed, and dynamic, easily outperforming its rivals. Wherever your journey takes you, Klipsch GIG XXL ensures the soundtrack is nothing short of spectacular.

The GIG XXL boasts two 6.5” full-range drivers and a dedicated 2” tweeter, all finely tuned with advanced DSP equalization. This configuration allows for lifelike sound reproduction at any volume, ensuring that both the highs and lows of your music are delivered with exceptional clarity and depth.
name: Klipsch Gig XXL Portable Party Speaker

description: Solidly built, the HiFi Rose RSA780 CD Drive can connect directly to your HiFi Rose High-Performance Streamers like the RS201E, RS250 or RS150B.
name: HiFi Rose RSA780 CD Drive

description: Matrix presents the Element X, a high-end network drive that is versatile, powerful and aesthetically pleasing. It opens the doors of high-fidelity music streaming and integrates cutting-edge technologies that enable it to support high-resolution files or even to ensure sound reproduction of astonishing richness, precision and depth. Its extremely well thought-out and meticulous design will delight any audiophile who wants to offer their HiFi audio system complete wireless connectivity.
name: Matrix Audio Element X - Open Box

description:
The Bluesound NODE is more than just a music player; it's a bridge to the vast universe of high-resolution music streaming and multi-room audio. This innovative device seamlessly integrates with your existing HiFi system or your favorite powered speakers, offering access to a world of music. With the NODE, you can explore hundreds of internet radio stations, numerous streaming services, and your personal digital music library, all controlled effortlessly through the BluOS Controller app on various devices.

Elevate your existing stereo setup to new heights with the Bluesound NODE. This device is not just about connectivity; it's powered by a cutting-edge Quad-Core 1.8ghz ARM® Cortex™ A53 processor and features a 32-bit/384kHz premium DAC design. The NODE ensures your music is not just played but experienced with exceptional clarity and depth.
name: Bluesound Node Wireless Music Streamer

description:
Moondrop Alice is a brand new flagship grade TWS designed with top-quality components and an optimized DSP structure to deliver an impressive sound performance that matches the performance of HiFi-wired IEMs. Alice comes equipped with ULT Super Linear Dynamic Driver with a third-generation DLC diaphragm coil. It brings us the perfect combination of the convenience of a TWS earphone and the performance of a wired set.

Moondrop Alice comes equipped with their in-house developed ULT Ultra-Linear dynamic driver unit. This is the same driver unit that they featured in their flagship Kato single dynamic driver IEMs. It adopts a third-generation DLC(Diamond-Like Composite) diaphragm coil for unparalleled sound performance.
name: Moondrop Alice True Wireless In-Ear Headphones

description:
Future-proof your beloved Focal Elex Headphones by picking up an extra pair or two of Focal Elex Ear Pads. These are the exact same pads that come on your Focal Elex and are shipped as a pair (no singles).

Like all of Focal's other ear pads, the Focal Elex ear pads are interchangeable across their line-up of high-end headphones which include the Focal Elear, Focal Clear, Focal Celestee, Focal Clear Mg, Focal Radiance, Focal Stellia and Focal Utopia. The Focal Elex ear pad is not compatible with the Focal Bathys.
name: Focal Elex Ear Pads (Pair)

description:

These the perforated ear pads are for AEON 2 Open, they may also be used with original AEON Flow Open. Made using the highest quality synthetic leather and featuring improved, more stable memory foam these ear pads will bring a new level of comfort to your headphone. NOTE: AEON Flow Open owners may want to consider the alternate perforated ear pads if a larger soundstage and a more vibrant midrange are desired.
name: Dan Clark Audio AEON 2 Perforated Ear Pads

description:
The S2 Floor Stand provides the perfect platform for your speakers to perform. Designed to partner LS50 Meta, LS50 Wireless II, and other KEF standmount speakers, they boast a mounting system with integrated cable management that allows wires to be hidden, and spike discs to protect wooden floors.

The S2 Floor Stands are designed by our UK engineering team to ensure your speakers sound their best, and deliver pristine, room-filling sound. They are the ideal height for driver positioning, and their steel plates and fillable aluminium tube structure provide the perfect platform.
name: KEF S2 Floor Stand

description:
Introducing the Dekoni Audio Elite Sheepskin Ear Pads and Dekoni Audio Elite Velour Ear Pads, tailor-made for the Audeze Maxwell headphones. Immerse yourself in the luxury of lambskin leather or velour and the acoustic precision that enhances your gaming and listening sessions.

Handcrafted from the finest materials, these replacement ear pads are not just about opulent comfort. They're engineered to elevate the Maxwell's award-winning sound, adding richness and clarity to every note.
name: Dekoni Audio Replacement Ear Pads for Audeze Maxwell Headphones

In the late 2000’s, Audio Technica changed the game releasing the original ATH-M50. The M50’s served not only the professional studio world, but also crossed over to the consumer mass market taking it by storm.

One of the best budget headphones, the sound is excellent, but the pads leave some room for improvement.

description:
The AudioQuest NRG-X2 US 2-prong Power Cable is designed to reduce distortion in your signal chain. To achieve this the power cord utilizes long-grain copper in a helical array geometry with cold-weld connections. The long-grain copper has less oxides, less impurities, and less grain boundaries than industry standard oxygen-free high conductivity copper, which reduces the amount of interference within the cable. The geometry of the design influences the basic electrical properties of the cable, such as inductance and conductance. The use of cold-weld connections insures that the joints between the cable and hardware have a reduced influence influence on the signal clarity.








Cold-Weld System

Instead of traditional hot solder connections, the cables utilize a high pressure point of contact connection with copper or silver-impregnated paste, which maintains the structural integrity of the cable with a reduced influence on the signal clarity





Geometry

The cable utilizes a helical-array geometry, wherein the conductors spiral around one another which provides significantly better clarity and dynamic contrast than if the conductors are wrapped in multiple twisted pairs or run in parallel





Conductors

The power cable utilizes semi-solid concentric packed long-grain copper (LGC) conductors which reduce distortion by having larger strands that do not change position along the length of the cable and have fewer oxides, less grain boundaries, and less impurities than industry standard oxygen-free high conductivity copper
name: AudioQuest NRG-X2 Power Cable

overviewFields.title: Hi-Res Audio Certified

overviewFields.title: Clean, Tight, Effortless Bass
overviewFields.value: MXT15’s dynamically balanced 5.25” woofer plays punchy, loud, and low, delivering Polk’s famously smooth mid-range and powerful, effortless bass.

overviewFields.title: Dolby Atmos Certified and DTS:X Compatible
overviewFields.value: Compatible with the latest Dolby Atmos and DTS:X surround sound enabled AV receivers and 4- and 8-ohm amplifiers, Monitor XT does not require specialized equipment to deliver great sound.
